name: strata
description: Strata — multi-asset momentum signal platform with Node API and Next.js dashboard

scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-clean.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @strata/api" "npm run dev --workspace @strata/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @strata/api && npm run build --workspace @strata/web
scripts.entry-scan: cd apps/api && npx tsx src/capitulation-scan-cli.ts | tee "capitulation-$(date +%m-%d-%H%M).log"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @strata/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @strata/web
